emails.subject: Your Honda Fit listing - still available?
emails.body: Hi - I saw your 2016 Honda Fit listed at $7,800. Would you take $7,400? I'd want to drive it first; Saturday morning is best for me. If it drives as clean as it looks I can move fast.

emails.subject: Honda Fit - I'll pay full asking
emails.body: I'll pay your full $7,800 asking price if it checks out in person. The catch is I'm only free on Sundays. Can you set up a Sunday test drive and not sell it out from under me before then?
